_comment: Prompt = styles[style] + ', ' + subject + ', ' + framing. Qwen-Image ignores negatives (L40S, 2026-11-12), so styles and framing describe what we want; negative is still sent for models that use it. All three styles ship (2026-11-13): paper is free, marker and clay are in-app packs. See docs/EMOJI_SET_PLAN.md §6.
_ship: Styles the app shows, in picker order; the first is the default and free. pack = id in handwritten_stickers/assets/packs/packs.json.

styles.marker: hand-drawn illustration in felt-tip marker and coloured pencil, confident visible strokes, slightly uneven dark brown ink outline, bold flat colours with light paper grain inside the shapes
styles.paper: flat paper-craft illustration: the subject alone, cut out of coloured paper as a few pieces that stay inside its own outline, clean scissor-cut edges, soft shadow under each piece, light gouache texture, nothing behind the subject: no stack of paper sheets, no backing card, no human silhouettes
styles.clay: soft 3D clay model, rounded smooth plasticine shapes with a satin finish, gentle studio light, vivid colours; an object is modelled as the plain object itself, never turned into a character or mascot, with no added body, arms or legs

framing: one single isolated subject shown whole, centred, filling about 80 percent of the frame, floating in empty space in front of a plain flat medium grey background, with no ground shadow and nothing under it
negative: text, letters, numbers, watermark, signature, logo, frame, border, white sticker outline, several subjects, cropped subject, photograph, realistic human skin, extra fingers, missing fingers

seed._formula: seed = base + per_item * n + k; k = 0..3 (hands category 0..7), retries continue with the next k
